news.headline: Brent back above $110 as Hormuz talks stall
news.what_happened: Brent rose ~1.4% to ~$110.3 and WTI ~1.3% to ~$99.1 after US-Iran talks over the Strait of Hormuz stalled (US wants the nuclear issue addressed first).
news.why_it_matters: Higher realisations help upstream producers; cost pressure for airlines, paints, tyres and a wider CAD/rupee risk for India.

news.headline: Nifty ends at 22,889 (-1.11%) on Monday; markets reopen after Dussehra holiday
news.what_happened: Sensex fell 876 pts to 73,853 on private bank and IT selling. HDFC Bank fell >2% after underwhelming results; Axis Bank fell 3.85% despite a 39% profit rise. PSU banks held up better. NSE was shut Tuesday.
news.why_it_matters: Private bank margin worries and high crude weigh on sentiment; GIFT Nifty indicates a flat open near 22,887.

news.headline: Wall Street mixed: S&P +0.28%, Nasdaq flat; US 10Y at ~5.1%
news.what_happened: S&P 500 edged up to ~7,713 while Nasdaq was flat; Asia mixed with Nikkei +1.2% and Hang Seng +0.2%. FIIs bought Rs 1,166 Cr on Friday after several days of selling.
news.why_it_matters: No strong global directional cue; elevated US yields cap FII appetite for EMs.

news.headline: RBI hiked repo 25 bps to 5.50% on 7 Oct, stance now calibrated tightening
news.what_happened: MPC voted unanimously for the hike; FY27 GDP seen 7.1%, CPI 5.2%; further hikes data-dependent.
news.why_it_matters: Headwind for rate-sensitive sectors (banks NIMs, NBFCs, real estate, autos).

sector_outlook.reason: Margin worries, RBI hike, weak results

picks.catalyst: Brent +1.4% to ~$110 on stalled Hormuz talks
picks.logic: Upstream realisation per barrel moves almost one-for-one with crude; ONGC outperformed (+1.4%) on a -1.1% Nifty day and has direct P&L leverage to $110 Brent.

picks.catalyst: Brent +1.4% to ~$110 on stalled Hormuz talks
picks.logic: Oil India is a pure-play producer with no downstream offset, so higher crude flows straight to realisation and earnings.

risks: Crude is headline-driven: a Hormuz deal would reverse upstream gains quickly
